sloka: स्वल्पम् हि कृतम् इन्द्रेण क्षिपता हि अशनिम् पुरा ।लक्ष्मणो निशितैः बाणैः भिन्द्यात् पत्र पुटम् यथा ॥४-५४-१४॥
transliteration: svalpam hi kṛtam indreṇa kṣipatā hi aśanim purā ।lakṣmaṇo niśitaiḥ bāṇaiḥ bhindyāt patra puṭam yathā ॥4-54-14॥

translations.english: 'In the past Indra had done a small damage (to the cave) with his thunderbolt. But with his sharp arrows Lakshmana will shatter the cave easily as though it is a leaf cup.
